backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the store backend, defining state and endpoints for user profiles, products, orders, carts, bills, recharge orders, and shop settings (UPI ID, slogan, status) with role-based access control and blob storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Canister upgrade migration module that converts the `upiId` field from optional (`?Text`) to required (`Text`), defaulting to a hardcoded UPI ID if previously null.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two implemented features: restoring the UPI Payment Settings card in AdminSettingsPage and dynamically fetching the UPI ID in BillTemplate for QR code generation, with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key behaviors of each component, page, and hook in the React frontend.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, radius, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React PWA, including viewport meta tags, PWA manifest link, Apple touch icon, Inter font import, and the root div for the React app.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest for Maa Bhawani General Store, specifying app name, icons, theme colors, display mode, and start URL.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first strategy for API/canister calls, with install, activate, and fetch event handlers.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that defines all client-side routes using TanStack Router, including public pages, admin pages, and new /search, /my-orders, and /wallet routes.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: A route guard component that restricts access to admin pages by checking a hardcoded credential login (stored in localStorage with a 24-hour session) and verifying the caller's admin status via a backend query.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: A form component for adding new products to the store, supporting fields like name, category, price, barcode, unit type, stock, and image (file upload or URL), with validation and submission via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a list of all products with inline stock editing, product removal, and toggling product exclusion, including a low-stock warning alert for items below 5 units.
frontend/src/components/BarcodeScanner.t: A camera-based barcode scanner component that dynamically loads the Quagga2 library from CDN, supports torch/flash toggling, scan cooldown, haptic feedback, and beep audio on successful scan.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Renders a searchable, filterable table of billing history with options to view or print individual bills in a dialog and export the filtered list as a CSV file.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: Renders a printable bill template for Maa Bhawani General Store, including order items, totals, delivery charges, a UPI QR code for payment, and buttons to print or share via WhatsApp.
frontend/src/components/BottomNavBar.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with four links (Home, Search, My Orders, Wallet) that highlights the active route using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Floating action button fixed to the bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to the store's number when clicked.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Slide-in cart drawer that displays current cart items with quantities and totals, and provides clear-cart and checkout actions while respecting shop open/closed status.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: Horizontally scrollable row of category filter buttons that highlights the selected category and calls a callback when a new one is chosen.
Static alert component that displays the store's delivery fee policy (free above ₹51 within 1km, ₹5 below, ₹20/km beyond).
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React class-based error boundary that catches rendering errors and displays a destructive alert with error details, a stack trace, and options to retry or go home.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Page footer showing store name, contact details (phone and Google Maps link), delivery info, and a copyright notice with a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky top header with the store logo, shop open/closed indicator, admin dashboard link, cart icon with item count badge, and login/logout button using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/HeroBannerCarous: Auto-advancing carousel component displaying three promotional store banners with navigation arrows, dot indicators, and a 4-second auto-play interval.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper that renders Header, Footer, CallUsButton, and conditionally shows BottomNavBar and WhatsAppHelpButton for non-admin routes.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: Section component for placing mobile recharge orders, featuring a form dialog with operator selection, mobile number input, and amount validation, disabled when the shop is closed.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Card component that displays a UPI payment QR code image along with the order amount and step-by-step payment instructions.
frontend/src/components/PhoneNumberSetup: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Card component for a single product showing its image, name, category, price, stock status, and an Add-to-Cart button that is disabled when the shop is closed.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Renders a responsive two-column grid of ProductCards filtered by category, with skeleton loading states and an empty-state illustration.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedBanner: Displays a red full-width banner announcing the shop is closed, rendered only when shop status is confirmed as closed.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedChecko: Alert dialog that appears when the shop transitions from open to closed (or is externally triggered), prompting the user to return to the home page.
frontend/src/components/ShopStatusToggle: Admin toggle switch for opening or closing the shop, showing live status labels and error alerts for fetch or update failures.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppHelpButt: Fixed floating button that opens a WhatsApp chat with the store's number, positioned above the bottom navigation bar.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) actors, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider component and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for backend interactions including user profiles, admin checks, shop status, products, orders, bills, and recharge orders.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, and includes print styles and a barcode scanner laser animation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page displaying tabbed views for managing orders (with status progression actions), products, bill history, and shop status toggle.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page allowing configuration of the shop slogan, UPI payment ID, and an emergency shop-close action with confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: In-store billing page that lets staff search products, scan barcodes, manage a cart, and generate a printable bill with customer details.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Customer checkout page that collects delivery details and payment method (UPI or COD), calculates delivery fees, and places an order via mutation.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main storefront page displaying a hero carousel, shop-closed banner, category filter, product grid, and mobile recharge section.
frontend/src/pages/MyOrdersPage.tsx: Placeholder page for order history that displays a coming-soon message.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page that shows the order ID, payment method, and either a UPI QR code or cash-on-delivery instructions based on the selected payment method.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Placeholder page for product search that displays a coming-soon message.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Static store information page showing contact details, hours, delivery policy, services, and an embedded Google Maps iframe.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx: Placeholder page for wallet/cashback functionality that displays a coming-soon message.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based colors, border radii, fonts, shadows, and accordion keyframe animations. Includes the typography, container-queries, and tailwindcss-animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest for 'Maa Bhawani General Store' tracking version, architectural notes, known issues, existing features, and pending feature requests — primarily focused on restoring UPI Payment Settings, dynamic QR code generation, and persistent stable-variable storage in the Motoko backend.
